name: Librespeed
description: Librespeed is a very lightweight Speedtest implemented in Javascript, using XMLHttpRequest and Web Workers.
short_desc: Librespeed is a very lightweight Speedtest implemented in Javascript, using XMLHttpRequest and Web Workers
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: Set the password for the results database.

form_fields.label: CUSTOM_RESULTS
form_fields.hint: (optional) set to true to enable custom results page in /config/www/results/index.php.

form_fields.label: DB_TYPE
form_fields.hint: Defaults to sqlite, can also be set to mysql or postgresql.

form_fields.label: DB_NAME
form_fields.hint: Database name. Required for mysql and pgsql.

form_fields.label: DB_HOSTNAME
form_fields.hint: Database address. Required for mysql and pgsql.

form_fields.label: DB_USERNAME
form_fields.hint: Database username. Required for mysql and pgsql.

form_fields.label: DB_PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: Database password. Required for mysql and pgsql.

form_fields.label: IPINFO_APIKEY
form_fields.hint: Access token from ipinfo.io. Required for detailed IP information.
